name: copy-button
title: CopyButton
description: A copy button whose icon morphs into a check.

accessibility: The result is announced with a role="status" "Copied" message, not just shown.
Needs an accessible name via `label`, e.g. "Copy install command".
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) swaps the icons without animating.
